title: Balance and lock a counterweighted service arm
instruction: Support the loaded arm, slide its counterweight until the pin holes align at the orange index, insert the locking pin through both holes, and leave the arm level with both hands clear.
context: The redesigned task balances a freely pivoted loaded service arm by changing the counterweight moment, then pins the sliding weight against drift. The robot must support the arm during adjustment and leave it balanced after release.
setup: Bimanual YAM station; x forward, y left, z up; metres/kg/radians; XYZW quaternions. Tabletop z=0.7475 m. Fixed layout, seed 0, no object jitter. Each object below is an authored rigid body or cable-chain link; dimensions are collision envelopes. Shapes, local offsets, colors and joints are fully enumerated in scene.json. pedestal: rigid material, 1.2 kg, envelope (0.13, 0.12, 0.104) m, origin (0.285, 0, 0.7475), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). service_arm: rigid material, 0.36 kg, envelope (0.29, 0.246, 0.059) m, origin (0.285, 0, 0.8475), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). counterweight: rigid material, 0.3 kg, envelope (0.044, 0.098, 0.0855) m, origin (0.25, 0, 0.8675), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). locking_pin: rigid material, 0.025 kg, envelope (0.022, 0.022, 0.064) m, origin (0.32, -0.24, 0.7757), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). pin_stand: rigid material, 0.12 kg, envelope (0.022, 0.022, 0.014) m, origin (0.32, -0.24, 0.7475), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1).
scoring: 0.3 for counterweight_aligned; 0.3 for counterweight_pinned; 0.4 for released_arm_balanced. Each goal requires all numeric predicates in SCORING.md and scene.json. Credit is recomputed, so dislodged components lose credit. Full score also requires all bodies <=0.01 m/s and <=0.2 rad/s, robot clearance >=0.02 m, continuously for 3.0 s; otherwise score is capped at 0.95. Invalid frames, lost parts, fixture motion, broken preservation constraints, joint-limit violations or penetration >0.002 m permanently score zero.
run_limit: 4800 control actions at 20 Hz (240 simulated seconds maximum)
reset_notes: Native reset restores the authored layout and zero joint coordinates, settles through the official adapter, clears scorer history, and records a new episode. Native probes compare two reset repetitions within 3 mm. Seed 0; object_jitter=0.
fidelity: A damped, unpowered pivot and explicit mass/center-of-mass values model a loaded service arm. Prismatic guidance approximates the counterweight rail; a free pin enters collision-defined holes. The pivot has no centering spring. This replaces generic fault replacement.
scores: NOT RUN: native physics, expert demonstrations and Dream-1 evaluation have not been executed.
